title: spendsum: crash on an Excel-style CSV export, root cause is three layers below the stack trace (Node, debugging)
prompt:
The expense report of our `spendsum` tool crashes on the March export:

```
$ node bin/spendsum.js report data/march.csv --month 2026-03
/home/dev/spendsum/src/cli.js:37
    throw e;
    ^

TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'startsWith')
    at inMonth (/home/dev/spendsum/src/ledger.js:23:19)
    at summarize (/home/dev/spendsum/src/ledger.js:30:19)
    at Object.main (/home/dev/spendsum/src/cli.js:30:28)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/home/dev/spendsum/bin/spendsum.js:3:42)
    at Module._compile (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1706:14)
```

The February report (`data/feb.csv`) works fine. `data/march.csv` is the first export from the company's new accounting system (it was opened and saved with Excel). Find out what is wrong and fix it properly, so that `spendsum report` gives the correct report for the March file and for any other file written the same way. Do not silence real input errors: bad amounts and unknown currencies must still be reported as README.md describes. Add regression tests under `test/` (keep the existing tests passing). Before you finish, run the report on `data/march.csv` and check the numbers yourself.
